# LES NRG

> LES NRG is a building performance testing and consulting firm based in Philadelphia, PA.

## About

LES NRG provides air leakage testing, energy ratings, building certification, and consulting services for residential and commercial buildings. The firm has completed over 4,000 blower door tests, certified 347 Energy Star units, and verified 25 PHIUS (Passive House) units across more than 20 years of experience.

## Services

- Blower door testing for code compliance (ASTM E779 and E3158)
- Large building multi-fan air leakage testing for commercial and industrial facilities
- HERS ratings (accredited RESNET HERS Rater)
- Residential energy audits with energy modeling and HERS score generation
- PHIUS Passive House verification and certification
- Energy Star Multifamily New Construction certification
- DOE Zero Energy Ready Home verification
- Indoor airPlus verification
- Duct blaster testing, ventilation testing, thermal enclosure verification
- Envelope commissioning
- Air leakage special inspection
- Building science consulting
- Expert witness services for Energy Star and code compliance disputes

## Credentials

- HERS Certified Rater (RESNET Accredited)
- PHIUS Verifier (Passive House Institute US)
- Energy Star for New Homes Partner
- NJCEP Partner (New Jersey Clean Energy Program)
- Indoor airPlus Verifier
- Zero Energy Ready Homes Verifier
- ABAA Level I Certified Whole Building Airtightness Technician
- Master's Degree in Construction Management

## Service Area

Philadelphia, PA (headquarters). Serves Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York, Delaware, and beyond.
